statement: Let F have characteristic zero, and let 0 ̸= f ∈ F⟨x1, . . . , xn⟩ have a formula of size at most s. There are m ≤ 2s, a nonzero constant row u, a constant column v, and an invertible matrix G ∈ F[[z]]m×m such that G′ = AG, G(0) = Im, A(z) = P(z) q(z) , q(z) = n Y i=1 (z + i), deg P ≤ n − 1, (8) where P is a polynomial matrix. Moreover, hf (z) = X w fwhw(z) = uG(z)v ̸= 0. (9)
